rules.title: JEE Main 2026 — upload photo
rules.source_title: National Testing Agency: JEE (Main) 2026 Information Bulletin

excerpts.text: The recent passport size photograph should be in colour with 80% face (without mask) visible including ears against white background. Photograph in JPG/JPEG format (clearly legible) between 10 kb to 200 kb.

unresolved.width: The bulletin gives no pixel width.
unresolved.height: The bulletin gives no pixel height.

notes: This exam also takes a live photo on its portal. This app cannot do that step.

rules.title: SSC CGL 2026 — signature
rules.source_title: Staff Selection Commission: Notice, Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (dated 21-05-2026)

excerpts.text: Candidates are required to upload the scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10 to 20 KB). Image dimension of the signature should be about 6.0 cm (width) x 2.0 cm (height).
The scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10 to 20 KB). The image dimension of signature should be about 4.0 cm (Width) x 2.0 cm (Height).

derived.aspect: 3:1 is derived from "about 6.0 cm (width) x 2.0 cm (height)" in para 9.6. The same notice's Annexure-IV says "about 4.0 cm (Width) x 2.0 cm (Height)" (2:1). The notice does not settle which is right.

unresolved.width: The notice gives centimetres only, with no DPI, so there is no pixel width to check.
unresolved.height: The notice gives centimetres only, with no DPI, so there is no pixel height to check.

notes: The photograph for this exam is captured live on its portal. This app cannot do that step.
